Beyond those two, timber sleeper suits garden-scale terracing, rock and boulder walls suit the granite-outcropped Darling Range hills, and besser block carries taller, engineered structural walls. Each service below explains what the system is, what drives the cost, and what Western Australia's building-permit and engineering rules actually require for it. Limestone Block Retaining Walls Natural and reconstituted limestone block walls - the material of choice on Perth's sandy Swan Coastal Plain blocks and a fit with the local streetscape. Post & Panel (Twin-Side) Retaining Walls Galvanised or concrete posts with precast concrete panels slotted between them - a fast, consistent-finish system widely used across Perth for boundary and driveway retaining. Besser Block (Core-Filled) Retaining Walls Core-filled, steel-reinforced concrete block walls for taller retaining and rendered finishes, an alternative to limestone on engineered walls. Timber Sleeper Retaining Walls H4-treated hardwood and pine sleeper walls for gardens, terraces and low boundary retaining. Rock & Boulder Retaining Walls Natural stone and boulder walls battered back for a rugged, free-draining finish that suits Perth hills blocks and granite-outcropped sites. Retaining Wall Drainage & Subsoil Systems Ag-drain, gravel and geofabric drainage behind every wall - the structural detail that stops failures in Perth's winter-saturated sandy ground. Engineered & Permit-Approved Retaining Walls Walls over 0.5m, on a boundary or carrying a surcharge, designed to AS 4678 by a WA-registered building engineering practitioner and permitted through your local government. Retaining Wall Repairs & Replacement Assessment, repair and full replacement of failing, bulging or cracked retaining walls across the Perth metro area. See our privacy policy . Common questions Do I need council approval for a retaining wall in Perth? A building permit from your local government is generally needed once a wall retains more than 0.5 metres of ground, and a wall of any height can need one if it is tied to other building work, affects or protects adjoining land, or affects a boundary wall or dividing fence. Some councils, including Wanneroo and Melville, also count the combined height of tiered walls toward that 0.5 metre figure. Always confirm the exact threshold with your local government before starting work. How much does it cost to repair a damaged retaining wall in Perth? Repair cost depends on the failure mode - a leaning timber sleeper section is a different job to a bulging block wall needing partial demolition and rebuild. An assessment of drainage, footing condition and material state is the starting point for an accurate repair quote. What legislation covers retaining walls in Western Australia? Building permits are governed by the Building Act 2011 (WA) and Building Regulations 2012, which set the 0.5 metre retaining wall exemption. Planning assessment (setbacks, site works height) uses the Residential Design Codes (R-Codes), and structural design for engineered walls is typically carried out to AS 4678 - Earth-retaining structures.
